summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase 3 Mobile-First Responsive Design for The Culinary Editorial. All 19 backend API tests pass (100%). All mobile responsive features tested and working: BottomNav, CartContext, CartDrawer, mobile layouts for HomePage, MenuPage, ProductDetailPage, CheckoutPage. Desktop layout preserved.

minor.issue: Fixed: BASE_URL was empty because REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL not set in backend env. Added fallback to FRONTEND_URL.

critical_code_review_comments: CartContext properly implements localStorage persistence for cart state
BottomNav correctly hidden on checkout, admin, and auth pages using location.pathname checks
CartDrawer uses vaul Drawer component with proper slide-up animation
Mobile layouts use flex-col-reverse for proper content ordering
Touch-optimized controls have 44px touch targets (mobile-qty-decrease/increase buttons)
Horizontal scroll on Currently Craving section works with 160px card width
Category pills on MenuPage are sticky and horizontally scrollable
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
seed_data_creation: Admin user seeded on startup via ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD env vars
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 mobile-first responsive design fully tested. All features working: (1) BottomNav shows on homepage/menu/orders/loyalty, hidden on checkout/admin/auth pages, (2) CartContext with localStorage persistence, (3) CartDrawer slide-up with quantity stepper and checkout CTA, (4) Mobile HomePage with flex-col-reverse hero, stacked collections, horizontal scroll craving section, (5) Mobile MenuPage with sticky category pills and full-width horizontal cards, (6) Mobile ProductDetailPage with sticky bottom bar and 44px touch targets, (7) Mobile CheckoutPage with single column layout and mobile CTA, (8) Desktop layout preserved with bottom nav hidden. Apple and Facebook social login buttons remain MOCKED (visual placeholders only).
